channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US allies in Asia wary as Trump moves military assets for Iran war
item.description: Allies worry about the US ability to deter China, even if the bulk of US forces remain in the region.

item.title: US designates Hezbollah an Iranian proxy, sanctions funding network
item.description: The US Treasury labels Lebanon-based group 'an extension' of the IRGC's Quds Force and takes aim at financing.

item.title: Closure of al-Makha port leaves workers and traders fearing for the future
item.description: Houthi attacks on al-Makha port forced it to suspend operations, leaving workers without jobs and traders concerned.

item.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
item.description: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.

item.title: Eight killed in plane crash at remote Alaskan military site, air force says
item.description: It is unclear why the civilian-contracted plane was at the radar site on Alaska's south-west coast.

item.title: Japan executes man who killed five in Pachinko parlour fire
item.description: This is the first time since June 2025 that the country has enacted capital punishment.

item.title: How much could Trump's 'economic D-Day' hurt Iran?
item.description: Iran has so far proved adept at finding ways around years of already punishing sanctions on its economy.

item.title: Multiple deadly Israeli strikes in Gaza in under 24 hours
item.description: BBC Verify looks at footage from two deadly strikes in under 24 hours in Gaza.
